title: Failure Atelier: Temporal Payload Lens & Retry Mapping
creator: Alyssa Chen
description:
Goal: Design a compact investigative workspace (the 'Failure Atelier') inside Redwood Console that stitches a failed request's temporal lifecycle with payload diffs, retry graphs, and contextual telemetry to speed up triage. This ticket covers the high-fidelity prototype, interaction spec, and a short usability script for a 30-minute research session with customer SREs.

Background: Current consoles show traces, logs, and raw payload snapshots in separate places. Engineers repeatedly switch between views to reconstruct retry behavior and payload divergence. We need a single surface optimized for step-through exploration of retry chains, API-layer errors, model fallbacks, and payload-level deltas.

Scope and constraints:
- Focus on failed request journeys (not general trace search).
- Support multi-try sequences (client retry, infra retry, model fallback) with clear causality arrows.
- Show payload diffs at each hop with ability to fold/unfold large blobs and highlight key fields (token counts, prompt templates, KV-cache markers).
- Include 'what-changed' delta summary auto-generated for each retry step plus quick-copy to reproduce in sandbox.
- Keep initial surface screen real-estate reasonable: target 1200px width main canvas, with collapsible right rail.
- Accessibility: color contrast for error classes and keyboard navigation for step-through.

Deliverables:
- Figma prototype with two flows: single-failure deep-dive and aggregate-retry-matrix exploration.
- Interaction spec (.md) for engineering: keyboard shortcuts, hover affordances, and collapse rules.
- Usability script and synthesis notes from 4 SRE sessions.
- Handoff artifact linking to a minimal design token palette and suggested console dashboard card for one-click jump to Atelier from a failed-requests list.

Acceptance criteria:
1) Designer demo of prototype to PM/ENG with walkthrough of both flows.
2) Two engineers can implement main canvas and right rail behaviors from the spec without additional clarifications.
3) Usability testing shows median task completion time under target (triage a two-try failure in <4 minutes) and qualitative sign-off from at least two SRE participants.

Open questions:
- How to surface KV-cache differences without leaking sensitive data? (Design will show structural diffs, masking PII by default, and provide an opt-in unmask for enterprise deployments.)
- How to indicate confidence about automated root-cause suggestions? (We propose a 'confidence ribbon' driven by heuristics from ENG.)
comments: 2025-02-13 - Alyssa Chen: Kicked off with low-fi sketches. Chose a two-column canvas: left for temporal lane (tries stacked with arrows), right for payload diff and metadata. Uploaded initial sketches to Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1ExampleSketches

2025-02-16 - Ravi Patel: Reviewed sketches with Eng (runtime team). ENG asked for an explicit model-variant indicator per try and a compact token-cost badge. Added to spec. ENG suggested relying on existing cost API endpoint (ENG-2412) to populate token counts.

2025-02-19 - PM Elena Morales: Suggested tying the Atelier entry point into the failed-requests dashboard as a 'Deep Investigate' quick action. PM flagged that enterprise deployments need audit logging when unmasking payloads; added to security constraints.

2025-02-22 - Alyssa Chen: Uploaded Figma mid-fi prototype: https://www.figma.com/file/ExampleAtelier. Prototype includes: stepper, retry-graph, diff-highlights, and sandbox reproduce button. Added interaction notes in the Figma file.

2025-02-24 - Usability session scheduling: Booked 4 SRE participants (two customers, two internal). Script focuses on two tasks: identify root cause in a multi-retry scenario, and reproduce failure in sandbox. Script drafted in Confluence: https://redwood.atl/confluence/display/UX/Failure+Atelier+Script

2025-02-28 - Research synthesis (notes): Early feedback: participants loved inline diff but asked for quicker filters: filter by error class, latency spike, or token delta. Action: add a small filter bar above the retry graph. Also asked for ability to pin a payload snapshot as a 'ground truth' for side-by-side comparison.

2025-03-02 - Engineering feedback (Ravi): Implementation trade-offs: continuous streaming of payload diffs is heavy; propose lazy-loading diffs and precomputing diffs at ingest. ENG will expose a diffs endpoint (ENG-2412) — dependency logged. Also flagged long blobs truncated with 'view full in sandbox' CTA.

2025-03-03 - Design decision log: 1) Use three-tier error taxonomy visuals (Client, Infra, Model) with colorblind-safe palette. 2) Mask payload fields by default; provide 'Reveal' with audit log. 3) Lazy-load diffs and prioritize tries by error severity. Logged in Drive spec and linked to PRD: https://docs.google.com/document/d/ExamplePRD
2025-03-04 - PM sign-off pending: PM asked for a short compliance review for masking rules. Added a follow-up task: coordinate with security for KMS/unmask guardrails (owner: PM Elena Morales).
handoff_notes: Engineering should implement: 1) retry-graph canvas with stepper state machine, 2) right-rail payload-diff component that supports masking and opt-in reveal, 3) minimal metrics: latency, token-count, error-class per try. Use precomputed diffs endpoint (ENG-2412). Keyboard nav: left/right step tries, 'D' toggles diffs, 'R' opens sandbox reproduce drawer.
implementation_risks: Large payloads causing OOM in client - mitigated by truncation and server-side diffing
PII leakage when unmasking - mitigated by audit log and enterprise opt-in flag
Accuracy of 'automated root cause' ribbons - must be explicit heuristics and not authoritative
qa_checklist: Entry point: Deep Investigate button from failed-requests list navigates to Atelier with selected request
Retry graph arrows correctly represent causal order and time deltas
Payload diffs show field-level additions/removals and token counts
Masking/unmasking triggers audit log entry (enterprise) and respects RBAC
Keyboard navigation and focus states meet A11y contrast rules
estimated_engineering_tasks: Backend: precompute payload diffs and expose diffs endpoint (ENG-2412)
Security: audit-log hook for unmasking and RBAC check
